about: Benchtop property meters: set-temp, method, calibrate, check, zero, measure (job), result, clean, status. Power, lids, stop and wait come from the shared layer. Ranges, enums and units come from each member's contract.

notes.jasco_p4200: polarimetry is optical (spectroscopy could list it as secondary)
notes.mt_hx204: built-in balance (balance class excluded it: weighing is a step of its drying run)
notes.mt_mp70: temperature program (thermal_analysis could list it as secondary)

reference.help: the density of the reference liquid at the set temperature

steps.step: compare the last density with the reference

measure.message: the U-tube of {inst} is not filled (fill.detected = {value}).
measure.fix: fill the sample bubble-free first - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
measure.label: U-tube filled

check.message: {inst} has no finished density reading of the reference liquid.
check.fix: measure the reference first: `chemlab run {inst} measure --wait`.
check.label: a finished reading

acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot start: it needs power, a filled U-tube, the cell within 0.05 K of the set temperature and no other run.
acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: check `chemlab run {inst} status`; wait for the temperature (`chemlab run {inst} set-temp T --wait`).

calibration.check:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} needs a finished density reading at the reference temperature to check against.
calibration.check:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: measure the reference liquid at its reference temperature first (`set-temp`, `measure --wait`).

unsupported.calibrate: every density adjustment of the DMA 5002 needs two fills exchanged by the operator during the procedure (air then water, or two standards; manual pp.24-33); a task has no operator mid-run
unsupported.zero: no blank or tare step: the U-tube is verified with air / water (`check`)

alternatives.calibrate: run `chemlab run antonpaar_dma5002 check --reference VALUE` with a reference liquid; the guided adjustment stays available with `chemlab call antonpaar_dma5002 adjustment.start` / `measurement.continue` / `adjustment.decide`.

measure: acquisition core (acquisition.start + density.measure); the touchscreen path measurement.start is not mixed in
the cell must be within 0.05 K of the set temperature (set-temp --wait first)
check: compares the last finished density with the reference at the set temperature (calibration.check); nothing is changed

standard.help: the certified refractive index nD of the standard at the set temperature

steps.step: start the one-point adjustment on the standard

measure.message: the prism of {inst} has no sample (sample.filled = {value}).
measure.fix: the sample is put on the prism with the lid open - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
measure.label: sample on the prism

measure.message: the lid of {inst} is open (angle {value} rad).
measure.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close lid` (or `chemlab call {inst} lid.set_angle --angle_rad 0`).
measure.label: lid closed

calibrate.message: the prism of {inst} has no sample (sample.filled = {value}).
calibrate.fix: the sample is put on the prism with the lid open - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
calibrate.label: sample on the prism

calibrate.message: the lid of {inst} is open (angle {value} rad).
calibrate.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close lid` (or `chemlab call {inst} lid.set_angle --angle_rad 0`).
calibrate.label: lid closed

check.message: the prism of {inst} has no sample (sample.filled = {value}).
check.fix: the sample is put on the prism with the lid open - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
check.label: sample on the prism

check.message: the lid of {inst} is open (angle {value} rad).
check.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close lid` (or `chemlab call {inst} lid.set_angle --angle_rad 0`).
check.label: lid closed

clean.message: the lid of {inst} is closed; the prism is cleaned with the lid open.
clean.fix: open it: `chemlab run {inst} open lid` (or `chemlab call {inst} lid.set_angle --angle_rad 1.57`).
clean.label: lid open

acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot start: it needs power, the lid closed, enough sample on the prism, a constant cell temperature and a method that fits.
acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: check `chemlab run {inst} status`; wait for the temperature (`chemlab run {inst} set-temp T --wait`).

adjustment.decide:NOT_ALLOWED.message: the adjustment result of {inst} cannot be applied (no valid reading of the standard).
adjustment.decide:NOT_ALLOWED.fix: check that the standard is on the prism and the lid is closed; calibrate again.

unsupported.zero: no blank or tare step: the prism is checked with a named check (`check "Water Check"`)

calibrate: one-point adjustment (adjustment.start type one_point) with the standard on the prism at the set temperature; applied only when the instrument recommends it (adjustment.decide)
check: NAME is one of the instrument's checks (checks.list, e.g. "Water Check"); the reference value belongs to the check

steps.step: switch the Na lamp on (the P-4200 switches it off after each reading)

standard.help: the certified rotation of the quartz control plate

steps.step: switch the Na lamp on (the P-4200 switches it off after each reading)
set the gain from the quartz plate

before.step: switch the Na lamp on (the P-4200 switches it off after each reading)

zero.message: the sample compartment lid of {inst} is open.
zero.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close lid` (or `chemlab call {inst} lid.set --opened false`).
zero.label: lid closed

zero.message: {inst} has no method (integration, repeats, declared concentration and path).
zero.fix: set it: `chemlab run {inst} method integration=1s repeats=3 conc=100g/L path=100mm`.
zero.label: method set

zero.message: no cell is in the sample compartment of {inst}.
zero.fix: the cell (blank, quartz plate or sample) is put in by the lab operator - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
zero.label: cell in place

calibrate.message: the sample compartment lid of {inst} is open.
calibrate.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close lid` (or `chemlab call {inst} lid.set --opened false`).
calibrate.label: lid closed

calibrate.message: {inst} has no method (integration, repeats, declared concentration and path).
calibrate.fix: set it: `chemlab run {inst} method integration=1s repeats=3 conc=100g/L path=100mm`.
calibrate.label: method set

calibrate.message: no cell is in the sample compartment of {inst}.
calibrate.fix: the cell (blank, quartz plate or sample) is put in by the lab operator - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
calibrate.label: cell in place

calibrate.message: {inst} has no blank reading at these conditions.
calibrate.fix: zero it on the blank cell first: `chemlab run {inst} zero`.
calibrate.label: blank read

measure.message: the sample compartment lid of {inst} is open.
measure.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close lid` (or `chemlab call {inst} lid.set --opened false`).
measure.label: lid closed

measure.message: {inst} has no method (integration, repeats, declared concentration and path).
measure.fix: set it: `chemlab run {inst} method integration=1s repeats=3 conc=100g/L path=100mm`.
measure.label: method set

measure.message: no cell is in the sample compartment of {inst}.
measure.fix: the cell (blank, quartz plate or sample) is put in by the lab operator - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
measure.label: cell in place

measure.message: {inst} has no blank reading at these conditions.
measure.fix: zero it on the blank cell first: `chemlab run {inst} zero`.
measure.label: blank read

measure.message: {inst} has no quartz calibration at these conditions.
measure.fix: calibrate it with the quartz plate: `chemlab run {inst} calibrate --standard 10.000deg`.
measure.label: quartz calibration

SAMPLE_KIND_MISMATCH.message: the cell in {inst} is not the kind this step needs (zero needs the blank cell, calibrate the quartz plate, measure the sample cell).
SAMPLE_KIND_MISMATCH.fix: the lab operator puts the right cell in; then retry.

REFERENCE_TEMPERATURE_MISMATCH.message: the set temperature of {inst} is not the reference temperature of the cell in it, or the cell is not within 0.2 K of it yet.
REFERENCE_TEMPERATURE_MISMATCH.fix: set the reference temperature (`chemlab run {inst} set-temp 20C --wait`).

BLANK_REQUIRED.fix: `chemlab run {inst} zero` with the blank cell.

QUARTZ_CALIBRATION_REQUIRED.message: {inst} needs a fresh quartz-plate reading (and a blank) before this.
QUARTZ_CALIBRATION_REQUIRED.fix: zero on the blank, then `calibrate --standard ...` on the quartz plate.

OPTICS_NOT_READY.message: {inst} needs power, the lid closed and the Na lamp on.
OPTICS_NOT_READY.fix: close the lid and switch the lamp on (`chemlab call {inst} lamp.set --enabled true`).

SAMPLE_METHOD_REQUIRED.message: {inst} needs a method and a cell in place.
SAMPLE_METHOD_REQUIRED.fix: `chemlab run {inst} method ...`; the cell is put in by the lab operator.

INVALID_CALIBRATION.message: the quartz factor of {inst} would be outside 0.1-10.
INVALID_CALIBRATION.fix: check the certified angle of the plate (sign and unit).

unsupported.check: the daily check runs on the touch-panel measurement path with registered jigs (daily_check.start, P-4000 application note pp.1-2); the class verbs use the acquisition core
unsupported.clean: no cell cleaning function (cells are cleaned off the instrument)

alternatives.check: `chemlab call jasco_p4200 daily_check.start --jig_id ...` on the touch-panel path.

zero: reads the blank cell (acquisition.start kind blank); a new blank clears the quartz calibration
calibrate: reads the quartz plate (acquisition.start kind quartz) and sets the gain (calibration.quartz); the simulated plate is acknowledged (accept_simulated_standard true)

standard.help: the certified value of the standard at its temperature (pH, or conductance in S)

method.fix: stop the recording first: `chemlab run {inst} stop`.
method.label: not recording

calibrate.fix: stop the recording first: `chemlab run {inst} stop`.
calibrate.label: not recording

calibrate.message: the reading of {inst} is not stable yet.
calibrate.fix: wait for the endpoint: `chemlab run {inst} measure --wait`, then calibrate.
calibrate.label: stable reading

measure.message: {inst} has no endpoint criterion (hold time and tolerance).
measure.fix: set it: `chemlab run {inst} method hold=5s tolerance=0.1%`.
measure.label: endpoint set

measure.message: the selected probe of {inst} is not installed or the meter is off (status {value}).
measure.fix: select an installed channel (`chemlab run {inst} method probe=ph`); probes are installed by the lab operator.
measure.label: probe installed

electrochemistry.calibrate:PRECONDITION_.message: {inst} did not calibrate: the value must be the certified value of the standard the probe stands in, for its channel and temperature (the meter recognises it within ±0.002 pH, or ±0.5 % for conductance and dissolved oxygen; manual p.88), with a fresh stable reading and no recording.
electrochemistry.calibrate:PRECONDITION_.fix: give the certified value of the buffer at its temperature (manual p.88 buffer tables) and check that the probe is in that standard; after a calibration measure again (`chemlab run {inst} measure --wait`), then retry.

unsupported.set-temp: no temperature control: the 914 only compensates its readings to a temperature (`method temp=25C` or `temp=auto`)
unsupported.check: no verification function: measure a second buffer and compare (`measure --wait`)

measure: the 914 measures continuously: measure waits until the endpoint criterion (method hold= tolerance=) is met; no native call
calibrate: one-point calibration of the selected channel (electrochemistry.calibrate); the value is the standard's certified value at its temperature (accepted within ±0.002 pH or ±0.5 %); a calibration resets the endpoint, so measure again before the next one

standard.help: the certified water activity of the verification standard at the set temperature

reference.help: the certified water activity of the verification standard

steps.step: compare the reading with the standard

measure.message: no sample cup is in the chamber of {inst}.
measure.fix: the cup is put in by the lab operator - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
measure.label: sample cup in

measure.message: the chamber lid of {inst} is open.
measure.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close lid` (or `chemlab call {inst} lid.set_angle --angle_rad 0`).
measure.label: lid closed

measure.message: the chamber lever of {inst} is not in the READ position.
measure.fix: turn it to READ: `chemlab call {inst} latch.set_angle --angle_rad 1.57`.
measure.label: lever at READ

calibrate.message: {inst} has no equilibrium reading of the standard.
calibrate.fix: measure the standard first: `chemlab run {inst} measure --wait`.
calibrate.label: equilibrium reading

check.message: {inst} has been on for {value} s; verification needs 15 min of warm-up.
check.fix: wait (`chemlab wait 900`) and measure the standard again.
check.label: warmed up

check.message: {inst} has no equilibrium reading of the standard.
check.fix: measure the standard first: `chemlab run {inst} measure --wait`.
check.label: equilibrium reading

acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot start: it needs power, the lid closed and latched, a sample, and the set temperature equal to the sample's reference temperature.
acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: check `chemlab run {inst} status`; set the temperature the sample was prepared for (e.g. `set-temp 25C`).

unsupported.zero: no blank step (the offset is set by calibrate)
unsupported.clean: no cleaning function (the chamber is cleaned by hand)

calibrate: measure the verification standard first; calibrate sets the linear offset so it reads the certified value (calibration.configure); measure again to read with it
check: compares the last equilibrium reading with the reference (calibration.verify); needs 15 min of warm-up

steps.step: single-point calibration on the 20 NTU standard

reference.help: the value of the verification standard

steps.step: compare the reading with the standard

measure.message: {inst} is still warming up (30 min with ratio on, 60 min with ratio off).
measure.fix: wait (`chemlab wait 600`) and retry.
measure.label: warmed up

measure.message: the lid of {inst} is open.
measure.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close lid` (or `chemlab call {inst} lid.set_angle --angle_rad 0`).
measure.label: lid closed

measure.message: the EPA filter of {inst} is not installed.
measure.fix: the filter is installed by the lab operator - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
measure.label: EPA filter

measure.message: no sample cell is in {inst}.
measure.fix: the cell is put in by the lab operator - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
measure.label: sample cell in

calibrate.message: {inst} has been on for {value} s; calibration needs 60 min of warm-up.
calibrate.label: warmed up 60 min

calibrate.message: {inst} has no stable reading of the 20 NTU standard.
calibrate.fix: measure the standard first: `chemlab run {inst} measure --wait`.
calibrate.label: stable reading

check.message: {inst} has been on for {value} s; verification needs 60 min of warm-up.
check.label: warmed up 60 min

check.message: {inst} has no stable reading of the standard.
check.fix: measure the standard first: `chemlab run {inst} measure --wait`.
check.label: stable reading

unsupported.clean: no cleaning function (sample cells are cleaned by hand)

calibrate: RapidCal: single-point calibration on a stable reading of the 20 NTU StablCal standard (calibration.rapid, 0-40 NTU); the full-curve calibration (calibration.start / read / store, the operator swaps several standards) stays available with chemlab call

standard.help: the osmolality of the standard (0 for pure water, then e.g. 400mOsmol/kg)

method.message: the method of {inst} changes only with no tube on the head.
method.fix: the lab operator takes the tube off first - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
method.label: no tube on the head

calibrate.message: no sample tube is on the measuring head of {inst}.
calibrate.fix: the tube is put on by the lab operator - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
calibrate.label: tube on the head

calibrate.message: the sample on {inst} is still frozen from the last run.
calibrate.fix: wait until it has thawed (`chemlab wait 60`).
calibrate.label: sample thawed

calibrate.message: the measuring head of {inst} is not in the measuring position ({value}).
calibrate.label: head down

calibrate.message: {inst} has warmed up for {value} s of 300 s.
calibrate.label: warmed up

measure.message: no sample tube is on the measuring head of {inst}.
measure.fix: the tube is put on by the lab operator - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
measure.label: tube on the head

measure.message: the sample on {inst} is still frozen from the last run.
measure.fix: wait until it has thawed (`chemlab wait 60`).
measure.label: sample thawed

measure.message: the measuring head of {inst} is not in the measuring position ({value}).
measure.fix: lower it: `chemlab call {inst} head.position --position measuring`.
measure.label: head down

measure.message: {inst} has warmed up for {value} s of 300 s.
measure.fix: wait (`chemlab wait 300`) and retry.
measure.label: warmed up

measure.message: {inst} is not calibrated (water zero and at least one standard).
measure.fix: calibrate: `chemlab run {inst} calibrate --standard 0` on water, then on a standard.
measure.label: calibrated

NOT_READY.message: {inst} is not ready: it needs power, 5 min warm-up, a method, a thawed sample tube on the head in the measuring position.

NOT_CALIBRATED.fix: calibrate on water (--standard 0) and a standard first.

CALIBRATION_GRID.message: {inst} takes standard values in 50 mOsmol/kg steps.

CALIBRATION_INVALID.message: the calibration points of {inst} would not be in order (a higher osmolality must freeze lower).
CALIBRATION_INVALID.fix: check the standard value and that the right standard is on the head.

CALIBRATION_RUN_REQUIRED.message: {inst} has no finished calibration run to accept.

METHOD_GRID.message: {inst} takes freezing and cooling temperatures in 0.5 °C steps (freeze above the cooling limit) and intervals in its time grid.
METHOD_GRID.fix: round them, e.g. freeze=-6C cool=-15C interval=1s.

UNLOAD_REQUIRED.message: the method of {inst} changes only with no tube on the head.
UNLOAD_REQUIRED.fix: the lab operator takes the tube off first.

unsupported.set-temp: no cell temperature set point: freezing and cooling temperatures are part of the method (`method freeze=-6C cool=-15C`)
unsupported.check: no verification function: measure a standard as a sample and compare (`measure --wait`)
unsupported.zero: the water zero is a calibration point: `calibrate --standard 0`

calibrate: a calibration run freezes the standard on the head (acquisition.start purpose calibration), then accepts its value (calibration.accept); water first (--standard 0)

measure.message: the drying unit of {inst} is open.
measure.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close lid` (or `chemlab call {inst} lid.set_position --position_m 0`).
measure.label: drying unit closed

measure.message: the pan of {inst} is empty ({value} kg).
measure.fix: the sample is spread on the pan by the lab operator - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
measure.label: sample on the pan

PAN_NOT_CLEAR.message: the pan of {inst} is not empty; tests and adjustments need an empty pan.
PAN_NOT_CLEAR.fix: the lab operator removes the sample; then retry.

NO_TEMPERATURE_KIT.message: the temperature kit of {inst} is not inserted.
NO_TEMPERATURE_KIT.fix: the lab operator inserts the temperature kit, or use the weight test / adjustment.

unsupported.zero: in its drying run (acquisition core) the analyzer weighs the sample at the start itself; tare (measurement.tare) belongs to the touchscreen measurement path (measurement.open), which is not mixed with it

params.wait_reason: the halogen heater is on only during a drying run

calibrate: NAME weight (default): internal weight adjustment; temperature: temperature adjustment (needs the temperature kit); procedure.start
check: NAME weight (default): internal weight test; temperature: temperature test (needs the kit)
measure: a drying run (acquisition.start) with the method's time; result = moisture content on the method basis

measure.message: {inst} has no method selected.
measure.fix: set one: `chemlab run {inst} method start=110C end=130C rate=1K/min criterion=transmission`.
measure.label: method selected

measure.message: no capillary is in the furnace of {inst}.
measure.fix: the capillaries are put in by the lab operator - the lab operator does this (it is not an instrument command); tell them what is missing.
measure.label: capillary in

acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot start: it needs power, a selected method, unused capillaries, and a start temperature below the expected melting point.
acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: check the method start temperature and `chemlab run {inst} status`; used capillaries are replaced by the lab operator.

unsupported.calibrate: the furnace adjustment needs stored calibration results of at least two reference substances 10 °C or more apart (touchscreen calibration analyses, user manual pp.17-23); use chemlab call analysis.* and adjustment.perform
unsupported.check: no verification function on the acquisition core: measure a reference substance and compare (`measure --wait`, `result`)

method: stores the method (method.configure) and selects it (method.select); name= sets its id (default chemlab)
result: onset and clear point of each capillary (--channel 1..4; all four without it)
